rows.ARS:
Pink blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Louise Estes
rows.Origin:
Bred by Joseph F. Winchel (United States, 1991).
Introduced in United States by Coiner Nursery in 1992 as 'Louise Estes'.
rows.Bloom: Pink blend, white reverse, ages to pink . Moderate, fruity fragrance. 35 petals. Average diameter 4". Large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, upright. Medium, matte, medium green foliage.

Height: up to 5' (up to 150cm). Width: up to 4' (up to 120cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 5b through 10b. Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant.
rows.Notes: Arena Rose Co.'s Catalog 2000 says Louise Estes is a light pink blend with a white reverse, darkening to a medium pink as the bloom ages... This rose honor Louise Estes, a dedicated rosarian and artist...

colour: Pink blend, white reverse, ages to pink .
